αἵματί: αἷμα — blood; neut. dat. sg., accent from the following enclitic τ’ ’with blood’
βοήσας: βοάω — shout, cry out; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having shouted’
βόθρου: βόθρος — pit, trench; masc. gen. sg., gen. of separation after verbs of drawing back
γενοίμην: γίγνομαι — become, come to be, be brought to; aor. opt. mid. 1 sg.: ’I might become’
γόου: γόος — wailing, lament; masc. gen. sg., + παῦσαι: ’from lament’
δειλοῖσι: δειλός — wretched, miserable; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οῖς)
λευκῷ: λευκός — white, bright, clear; neut. dat. sg. (ὕδατι λευκῷ ’with bright water’) · also masc. dat. sg., instrumental, agreeing with ὀδόντι: ’with a white tusk’
μέντῃ: Μέντης — Mentes, a Taphian chieftain, the guise Athena takes; dat. sg.
νεκρόν: νεκρός — dead body, corpse; masc. acc. sg.
νομῆες: νομεύς — herdsman, shepherd; masc. nom. pl., epic -ῆες (= Attic -εῖς)
πάτροκλόν: Πάτροκλος — Patroclus, Achilles’ companion; masc. acc. sg. (accent thrown back by enclitic γε)
παθέειν: πάσχω — suffer, experience; aor. inf., epic uncontracted παθέειν (= Attic παθεῖν)
πυθοίμην: πυνθάνομαι — learn, inquire; aor. opt. 1 sg. mid.
τεὴν: τεός — your, thy (epic = Attic σός); fem. acc. sg.
τινι: τις, τι — someone, anyone; indef. pron., dat. sg., after a negative: οὔ τινι ’to no one’
φρονέουσιν: φρονέω — think, have in mind; pres. 3 pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic φρονοῦσι)
ἀγάσσατο: ἄγαμαι — wonder at, be amazed, be indignant at; aor. mid. 3 sg.
ἀγαθοῖο: ἀγαθός — good, noble; adj., neut. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -οῦ)
ἁπαλοῖο: ἁπαλός — soft, tender; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -οῦ), agreeing with αὐχένος
ἐθέλῃ: ἐθέλω — be willing, wish; pres. subj. 3 sg., in an εἰ clause without κε: ’is willing’ · also with κεν in a general relative clause: ’may wish’ (ὅττι κεν ᾧ θυμῷ ἐθέλῃ ’whatever he may wish in his heart’)
ἐλαίης: ἐλαίη — olive tree (cultivated, as opposed to wild φυλίη); fem. gen. sg.
ἐπιμνησαίμεθα: ἐπιμιμνήσκομαι — call to mind, mention (+ gen.); aor. opt. 1 pl.: ’we called to mind’
ἐπῶρσε: ἐπόρνυμι — stir up, rouse against; aor. 3 sg., epic (ἐπ- + ὦρσε): ’stirred up’
ἔθηκας: τίθημι — put, make; aor. 2 sg. (κ-aorist): ’you made (them so-and-so)’
ἔπεφνες: φένω (aor. ἔπεφνον) — slay; aor. 2 sg., epic reduplicated aorist
ἔρνος: ἔρνος — young shoot, sapling; neut. acc. sg.
ὑπέρβιον: ὑπέρβιος — overweening, excessive; fem./neut. acc. sg. · also adverbial, neut. acc. sg.: ’exceedingly, with excessive violence’ (κτήματα δαρδάπτουσιν ὑπέρβιον)
